summary_en: ZUKEN INC. will cancel 1,174,284 treasury shares (5.3% of issued shares) effective November 30, 2026, reducing outstanding shares to 21,075,520.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On November 9, 2026, ZUKEN INC.'s Board of Directors resolved to cancel 1,174,284 treasury shares in accordance with Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation will be effective on November 30, 2026. The cancelled shares represent 5.3% of the issued shares prior to cancellation. Following the cancellation, the company's total issued shares will be reduced to 21,075,520.
